title: Grateful Dead Live at Santa Fe Downs on 1982-10-17
lineage: Reel (Technics RS-1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Sound Forge (WAV 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition 2020 > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC (24-bit/48k)

ai_review.summary: Great 1982 performance captured on a nicely recorded audience tape
ai_review.review: The show is praised as a great one, with the reviewer noting the pleasant surprise of hearing what the band was doing a year earlier. The audience recording (Aud) is described as “really nice,” indicating solid sound quality that makes the set enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 4‑star review highlights a strong performance and good audience recording; limited data keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls the Aud "really nice," suggesting clear, listenable sound with no major issues mentioned.
